data.one_liner: Create and set custom mouse cursors directly from a memory buffer on desktop platforms.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to register and set custom mouse cursors dynamically using raw memory buffers (PNG or raw BGRA). It integrates with Flutter's MouseRegion via a custom MouseCursor subclass.
use_when: You are building a desktop application for macOS, Windows, or Linux.
You need to create custom mouse cursors dynamically from image memory buffers.
avoid_when: You are targeting mobile or web platforms.
You only need standard system cursors provided by Flutter.
strengths: Enables dynamic custom cursors from raw memory buffers.
Provides a simple wrapper subclass of MouseCursor for easy integration.
weaknesses: Limited platform support to desktop operating systems (macOS, Windows, Linux).
Windows platform may have specific Flutter engine branch or version requirements depending on the engine PR status.
data.setup_notes: Requires registering the cursor data using CursorManager before applying it to a MouseRegion.
data.minimal_example:
cursorName = await CursorManager.instance.registerCursor(CursorData()
  ..name = "test"
  ..buffer = memoryCursorDataRawPNG
  ..height = img.height
  ..width = img.width
  ..hotX = 0
  ..hotY = 0);

MouseRegion(
  cursor: FlutterCustomMemoryImageCursor(key: cursorName),
  child: Text("Custom cursor region"),
)
